services.desc: Justine A. Chambers, One hundred more, 2024. Exhibition view at the Toronto Biennial of Art, 2024. Photography: Toni Hafkenscheid. Or Gallery presents One hundred more, an exhibition and residency with dancer and visual artist Justine A. Chambers, featuring the west coast premiere of One hundred more (2024), a video-based installation exploring gestures of resistance. Alongside the installation, Chambers will undertake a creative research residency and develop a public outreach program series, cumulatively supporting the development of a future choreographic work. services.desc: Free and open to the public, TURNING TABLES 2 is a hybrid art book market + exhibition that will shine a spotlight on over 30 local, regional, national, and international arts publishers and producers of art books, critical arts publications, zines, periodicals, and more. After the launch weekend, the show goes on during Critical Distance Centre for Curators’ regular gallery hours, Thursday-Saturdays 12-6pm, and by appointment, through December 19th.
